steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Runner Three, down!

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: Runner Seven, destroyed!

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Runner Eight, intercepted.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Raidian, execute the feint! Use your Arts to extend or hit their nervous systems directly!

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Pull all the enemies!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: *Pant* *pant*... so tough. Is everyone okay?

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: No problems yet... But... it's really intense. I've never seen combat on this scale before...

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: I'm due for a vacation if I make it back from this.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Right. I'll approve it.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: But first... let's knock out this team! Then if you want a raise, a vacation, a specific assignment, I'll grant anything!

steps.name: Guerrilla Fighter
steps.text: Incoming!

steps.name: Guerrilla Fighter
steps.text: Don't get distracted! Back in formation!

steps.name: Guerrilla Fighter
steps.text: A major firefight by the east exit? Stay calm, push ahead slow. Don't give them an opening!

steps.name: Guerrilla Fighter
steps.text: These don't look like Ursus or Yan tactics. What's going on? Who are they?

steps.name: Guerrilla Fighter
steps.text: After picking off Ursus soldiers for years, now we get ambushed?

steps.name: Guerrilla Fighter
steps.text: No actual fighting...? Cowards! You'll pay for underestimating the guerrillas!

steps.name: Guerrilla Fighter
steps.text: Watch the altar! The protection the Captain gave us only mitigates its effects. He told us a million times not to go near it unless we have to!

steps.name: Guerrilla Fighter
steps.text: Runner, get the other teams on the horn.

steps.name: Guerrilla Fighter
steps.text: ...No response?

steps.name: Guerrilla Fighter
steps.text: Where are the mortars? And the devils?

steps.name: Guerrilla Fighter
steps.text: Hold on. Something's not right.

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: Runner Twelve, destroyed!

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: The guerrilla fighters are closing ranks! Now's our best chance to break through!

options: No! It could be a trap!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Roger. Rosmontis, let's scan the area with our Arts.

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: I can't reach it. The enemy... is blocking me somehow.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Sarkaz casters. They're the only ones who could interfere with Arts like Rosmontis's.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Then it's up to me...!

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Raidian, how long can you keep it up?

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: ...We'll be quick.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I... I found them. Yes. They have a lot of snipers and casters hidden in those buildings.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: They're calm... some agitated. But they're not fanatics. They're... fortifying that point.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: ...Duty.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: The Doctor is right. It's a trap.

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: I'm nearby. I'm coming.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Can you do it?

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: Yes. I won't smash the whole building. I'll just destroy the level they're on, so they won't bother us.

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: Amiya, I can do it.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Right, Rosmontis... I know you can. Definitely.

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: ...Amiya, will you p'ei fu me then?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Err? What?

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: I heard Blaze say there aren't many people who can make you p'ei fu them.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: P'ei fu? Oh... does that mean 'respect?' Sorry, I'm not so good with the Yan language. I'm pretty sure that's what it means?

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: I don't know, Amiya...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: ...Doesn't matter. Because I've always 'p'ei fu'd' Rosmontis.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: You're amazing, really. I couldn't do what you do...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I couldn't bear that loss and loneliness.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: There's no way I could live with it like you do, suffer through it like you do.

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: You're lying.

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: But it doesn't matter to me. Even if you're a liar, you're still Amiya to me.

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: Someone could... p'ei fu... a person like me?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: It's like you just said, Rosmontis. You're Rosmontis, so I respect you. As both an elite operator and a friend.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Keep at it, Rosmontis.

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: Okay. We'll keep at it.

steps.name: Guerrilla Fighter
steps.text: Where are they? What are they waiting for?

steps.name: Guerrilla Fighter
steps.text: N-No! We can't leave the area! We strike as soon as they show their faces! No one else falls out of contact!

steps.name: Guerrilla Fighter
steps.text: Hey, is that an enemy on top of that building over there?

steps.name: Guerrilla Fighter
steps.text: ...A cat? Just one little Feline...?!

steps.name: Guerrilla Fighter
steps.text: Runner! Tell the casters! The enemy deployed a caster on the building across the way!

steps.name: Guerrilla Fighter
steps.text: We've gotta take her out!

steps.name: Guerrilla Fighter
steps.text: —A sword? A weapon? She's pulling them out of the air...

steps.name: Guerrilla Fighter
steps.text: Huh? Floating weapons?

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: Slice from here, to there.

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: Hold it... with my hands. Cut, with the sword.

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: ...Like slicing a potato.
Like slicing a potato.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Doctor! Get over here!

options: The whole building... got cut in half?

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Rosmontis is destroying the guerrillas' ambush point. Watch for falling debris!

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Assuming you're talking about Rosmontis's Arts, it may be time to explain it to you, now that you've seen it so many times.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: It is a state of mind she shapes herself. You can think of it like Rosmontis has a gigantic, second, invisible body that cannot be acted upon.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: It is a formless extension of her sense of touch. She can grab, squeeze, lift up, and toss away.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: But these Arts lack objective manifestation, as opposed to her subjective mind.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: It can act upon us with force, but we cannot act upon it. We only know it exists with the application of special Originium Arts.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: You need not grasp it fully. This is not your area of expertise.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Rosmontis was much more destructive before we put a weapon in her hands. A lot like being crushed beneath the treads of a nomadic city. All that's left is a crying young girl alone in the ruins.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Under no circumstances can that be allowed to happen again.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: ...Doctor, move.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: I see it. The command group is coming...

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: There should be a waterway under the ruins of the park fountain.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: They hid in such an inconspicuous place.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: ...The story of the ambush on Graymane Peak, that supposedly involved seven straight days of stakeout and tricked the strongest of knights, may well have been true.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Let's go, Dr. {@nickname}. No time to lose.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Raidian, cease fire. Find a good place to hide. I need you to focus on keeping our comms up.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Mantra-2, log all our conversations. Every last word.

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: Runner Group Fourteen, successfully intercepted.

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: Amiya, Dr. Kal'tsit, I'm ready.

steps.name: Guerrilla Fighter
steps.text: (Are you okay...? Talk to me! Look at me!)

steps.name: Guerrilla Fighter
steps.text: (Good, you're with us. I'm okay. Doesn't matter. You hide somewhere, don't let them find you... we need you to regroup.)

steps.name: Guerrilla Fighter
steps.text: (I know. We'll get them. You stay quiet!)

steps.name: Guerrilla Fighter
steps.text: (I'm fine. No injuries. A little stone is nothing compared to an Ursus Fortcracker.)

steps.name: Guerrilla Fighter
steps.text: (Don't panic! I can stop it, you look for an opening!)

steps.name: Guerrilla Fighter
steps.text: You! What are you looking at?! Too scared to fight us?

steps.name: Guerrilla Fighter
steps.text: Whoever you are, you lost the guts to take us on now? Too scared of Patriot's blood? Scared of his witchcraft?

steps.name: Guerrilla Fighter
steps.text: Thinking back to the time you fought the Sarkaz? You had them outnumbered, you could've won, but in the end you just ran up the casualties!

steps.name: Guerrilla Fighter
steps.text: But we'll do you one better! You can't break our shields, you can't crack our armor! You're nothing before the undying Patriot!

steps.name: Guerrilla Fighter
steps.text: The mightiest Ursus warrior... needs no spear or shield. He'll stomp you to pieces.

steps.name: Guerrilla Fighter
steps.text: You... are nothing!

steps.name: Guerrilla Fighter
steps.text: Our fighters will regroup here soon! You can't run. Reunion will put you through hell!

steps.name: Guerrilla Fighter
steps.text: Oppressors who enslave the Infected like us! You will be swallowed up by the Reunion movement!

steps.name: Guerrilla Fighter
steps.text: Reunion—

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: ...Reunion already betrayed you, sir.

steps.name: Guerrilla Fighter
steps.text: —Little girl?

steps.name: Guerrilla Fighter
steps.text: ...Two... Infected little girls?

steps.name: Guerrilla Fighter
steps.text: What are you doing?!

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: Out of the way.

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: There's a man behind you, and I'm going to break the device behind him.

steps.name: Guerrilla Fighter
steps.text: You think I'll show you mercy just because you look like a kid?

steps.name: Guerrilla Fighter
steps.text: Don't underestimate Patriot's Guard! We're the Aegis of the Infected... I'm here to stop your attack.

steps.name: Guerrilla Fighter
steps.text: If you attack the Infected, I'll strangle you with my own two hands!

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: Then my weapons will talk for me.

steps.name: Guerrilla Fighter
steps.text: You... You're the cat from before.

steps.name: Guerrilla Fighter
steps.text: Your sword...

steps.name: Runner
steps.text: (Get out of here, guardian! Tell the others! I'll be okay!)

steps.name: Guerrilla Fighter
steps.text: (That's your job, not mine! You have to survive!)

steps.name: Guerrilla Fighter
steps.text: Come, try to pierce my shield! Try to break my armor!

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: Amiya. I'm out of options.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: But...

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: He won't die. But he may never walk again.

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: Go. Stab...
You, can't.

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: How... you blocked my sword with your bare hands?

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: Hm... My hand... numb...

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: When did you get here? I never felt...

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: No. Oh... I think... I thought that was a building collapsing, but that was you?

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: You, no, you and your team... You're like...

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: ...a mountain.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Rosmontis, fall back.

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: But I...

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: That's an order, Rosmontis.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: An order.

steps.name: Guerrilla Fighter
steps.text: Captain...!

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: You did, well. Go, regroup.

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: Now, you...

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: Rhodes Island.

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: I don't care, who, you are.

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: You attacked, my men. You, die.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Are you sure you don't care?

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: Very, sure—

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: Wait... wait.

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: You...

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: ...Buldrokkas'tee.

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: You... how...?

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: It's been a while.

steps.name: Patriot
steps.text: You... Dame Kal'tsit?
